evidence.quote: Online pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal is mandatory for all non-EU students residing abroad (see point 6) who require a Study Visa to enter Italy and enrol at Sapienza.
Identity Document: A valid passport (or identity card for EU citizens only).
Study Visa: A "University Enrolment" visa issued by the Italian Diplomatic Mission (Embassy or Consulate) in the candidate’s country of residence.
Original High School Diploma and an official sworn translation (Italian or English).

notes: Tuition left out: the only amounts given are Sapienza-wide and depend on ISEE band or on the country of income (Importi ordinari dei contributi di iscrizione, art. 38), not a single stated tuition for this programme. The programme page states "Modalità di accessoProva di ammissione" (admission test), so admission requires an entrance test. Deadline/opening dates for the intake are not given for this programme: the International Student Office page dates refer to the pre-selection/Universitaly procedure and to A.Y. 2026/2027, but for a restricted-access programme students must follow the specific Call for Applications in the Course Catalogue, so no intake date is stated for this programme here. Document list taken from the general Bachelor's/single-cycle enrolment page; note translation is only required for qualifications not originally issued in English. Application channel: pre-selection is on MoveIN ("Complete a pre-selection application on MoveIn") but the mandatory pre-enrolment for non-EU visa applicants is on Universitaly.

evidence.quote: High School Diploma: Must be obtained after at least 12 years of schooling and grant access to first-level university degrees in the country of issuance.
